name: Retell a short spoken account
short_description: Retell a short spoken account once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can retell a short spoken account in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Retell a short spoken account means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Retell a short spoken account in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Write a short instruction helps develop retell a short spoken account but is not indispensable.
This earlier capability remains useful but is not required by the revised route.
